coordinateSystem: Zero based pixels; normalized coordinates divide by full canvas dimensions. Edge positions are exclusive.
uiAesthetic: Four green monochrome colors, chunky square pixel borders and high-contrast flat plates.

scorePanel.measurement: Centers of bounding rectangles of the two largest enclosed dark fill connected regions.

net.whiteTapeEquivalent: Light green upper mesh tape is sloped. Reference y is its center at post attachment x84.

spriteAlignment.reference: anime90-full-v1 corresponding final sprites alpha > 8 bounds
spriteAlignment.method: Crop generated source alpha bounds, resize width and height to rounded master bounds on 128 logical grid, center horizontally and bottom align to y496; nearest integer 4x. Sheets are half final sprite size.

logicalResolution.details: Per-file logicalWidth and logicalHeight in manifest.json
